beliefs: f removes all whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, newlines, carriage returns, and Unicode whitespace like NBSP, em space, vertical tab, ideographic space) from the input [E1, E2]
f leaves all other characters (letters, digits, punctuation, format chars, zero-width chars, NUL, DEL) unchanged [E1, E6, E16, E17]
f maps empty string to empty string [E1]
f filters per code point, so lone surrogates and combining marks pass through unchanged and whitespace between them is removed [E18, E20]
f's whitespace set matches Python str.isspace() exactly, including U+001C-U+001F, U+0085, U+000B, U+000C, U+1680, U+205F, U+2000-U+200A [E9, E19]
notes: E20's 0.80 match was a scoring artifact of lone-surrogate handling in the harness, not a rule difference; the per-code-point isspace() filter already reproduces every observed output, so the model is unchanged.
